storyCards.headline: Love Will Keep Us Together: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
The Captain's "Love Will Keep Us Together" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 23 weeks on the chart.

Love Will Keep Us Together was released in 1975.

"Love Will Keep Us Together" by The Captain.

Chart story — peaked at #1 on the Hot 100.
